rows.grounds: compound: lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (letter) + rāśi (mass/heap) + stha (abiding/situated); object of the act denoted by kṛtya
a lakh; quantity of repetitions to be performed
absolutive indicating completion of the prescribed repetition
compound vocative: sura (god) + arcita (worshipped); address to the recipient of instruction

items.question: What ritual act of repetition secures the guarded Kaula extraction?
premises: A hundred-thousand repetitions must be performed.
The repetitions are situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: Performing a hundred-thousand repetitions abiding in the forehead's letter-mass accomplishes the required act.
uncertainties: The exact referent of varṇa-rāśi (specific mantra letters or a visualized cluster) is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
